title: Electric Service Agreement Desk Guidance: Notice-Avoidance Bank Draft Payments
content:
## The rule the desk applies

When a customer asks how much to pay now so that an **Electric Service Agreement** no longer meets the past-due minimum for a written disconnection notice, the customer authorizes a one-time bank draft for the notice-avoidance amount from the business or household checking account, and the draft is posted that day under the confirmation number the payment channel issues. A bank draft authorized on the call is posted once, under the one confirmation number its authorization produces.

A bank draft is taken only while the payments on the agreement reversed as returned unpaid in the schedule's returned-payment restriction look-back stay below the schedule's returned-payment restriction count; at or above that count no bank draft is taken.

## When the amount is fixed

The notice-avoidance amount is fixed only after every closed agreement of the customer whose final bill has stayed unpaid for the prior balance transfer period carries a balance transfer credit.

The notice-avoidance amount is not fixed until the agreement carries the chronic-outage credit owed once its outage records reach the chronic threshold.

## Invocation

The tool is `authorize_bank_draft_payment_056776f4`. It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorize the draft.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | The service account number of the agreement the customer is paying, as the agent reads it out from the service agreement lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | The draft amount in USD | positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half-up to the cent when posted |

## Return

A confirmation sentence stating the bank draft confirmation number (an opaque reference beginning EFT-), the amount drafted in USD to 2 decimal places, the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the agreement's new balance owed in USD to 2 decimal places. Receiving this sentence means the payment is posted and the agreement's balance owed has fallen by the amount.
